tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across all parsed SEC/FDA/register/weather section bodies (BM25 ranking). Also resolves company names for ticker lookup.

tools.name: dossier
tools.description: Cross-topic dossier for one entity — SEC filings, 13F holdings, mutual fund holdings, FDA recalls as firm, federal register agency mentions, federal contracts as recipient.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Comprehensive dossier for one SEC-filing company: basic info, recent filings, insider activity windows (7/30/90d), upcoming Form 144 sales, latest financials (FY+quarterly), top 13F institutional holders, top mutual-fund holders, peers.

tools.name: company_risk_flags
tools.description: Multi-source red-flag detector for one company — restatements (8-K item 4.02), auditor changes, officer departures, insider cluster sells, upcoming Form 144 pressure, Schedule 13D filings, FDA recalls.

tools.name: company_insider_pulse
tools.description: Unified Form 4 (executed) + Form 144 (proposed-sale) insider timeline for one company.

tools.name: cluster_buys
tools.description: Companies where multiple distinct insiders bought open-market stock in the window. Strong conviction signal.

tools.name: cluster_sells
tools.description: Companies where multiple distinct insiders sold open-market stock in the window. Mass-exit detector.

tools.name: upcoming_sales_pressure
tools.description: Lists companies by the size of insider sales planned in recent SEC Form 144 notices (filed intentions to sell, not completed trades).

tools.name: news
tools.description: Time-ordered cross-topic news feed: insider trades, Form 144 notices, cluster buys/sells, Schedule 13D filings, 8-Ks, FDA recalls, weather alerts, presidential documents.

tools.name: estimate_filing_dates
tools.description: Estimates each company's next 10-Q/10-K filing date from its past SEC filing cadence. Dates are estimates, not announced filing dates.

tools.name: fund_holdings
tools.description: What a mutual fund holds (NPORT-P). Pass a 10-digit CIK or series_id (S000012345).

tools.name: fda_firm_dossier
tools.description: All FDA activity for one firm — recalls + 510(k) clearances + FAERS adverse-event reports.

tools.name: drug_label
tools.description: Look up an FDA drug label by brand, generic, or substance name. Returns indications, dosage, warnings, adverse reactions, drug interactions.

tools.name: watchlist
tools.description: Consolidated activity rollup for a list of tickers — insider 30d net flow, Form 144 pressure, recent material events, cluster-sell flag. Up to 25 tickers per call.

tools.name: cross_vertical_active
tools.description: Discovery feed: list of entities with activity in 2+ regulatory verticals (SEC + FDA + contracts) inside the lookback window. Use to find entities worth pulling a full cross-vertical timeline for.

tools.name: entity_timeline
tools.description: Cross-vertical event timeline for one real-world entity — joins SEC filings/insider/Form144/13D + FDA recalls + FDA drug labels + federal contracts into one ordered feed. Use this when an LLM needs the FULL picture of a company across regulatory verticals. Add min_importance to filter to high-signal

tools.name: entity_material_events
tools.description: Cross-vertical 'alert me' feed for one entity. Returns only high-signal events (importance ≥ 60): Class I FDA recalls, Schedule 13D filings, large insider sales, restatements, large federal contracts, terminated clinical trials, EPA significant-violator status.

tools.name: clinical_trials_recent
tools.description: Recent clinical trial activity from ClinicalTrials.gov. Filter by phase, status, and sponsor. Use for drug pipeline questions.

tools.name: lobbying_by_client
tools.description: Aggregate Senate Lobbying Disclosure dossier for one company: total spend, firms used, top issue codes, recent filings.

tools.name: epa_facilities
tools.description: EPA-regulated facilities owned by a company. Returns location, NAICS, and compliance status. Set violations=1 to only see facilities with EPA violations.

tools.name: patents_recent
tools.description: Recent USPTO patent grants from PatentsView. Filter by assignee company or CPC class. Use for R&D intel and IP portfolio questions.

tools.name: patents_by_assignee
tools.description: Aggregate USPTO patent dossier for one company: total grants, top CPC classes, recent grants, inventor counts.

tools.name: courts_recent
tools.description: Recent federal court dockets from CourtListener. Filter by party, court, or Nature of Suit (850 securities, 830 patent, 410 antitrust, 365/367 product liability, 480 consumer credit).

tools.name: courts_by_party
tools.description: Litigation dossier for one company: docket count, top Natures of Suit, recent cases. Answers 'is this company being sued?' and 'for what?'

tools.name: sanctions_check
tools.description: Search MORVS's partial local OFAC SDN index by case-insensitive substring, including indexed aliases. Returns hit=true for a local match. A non-match is not sanctions clearance; check /coverage and OFAC's current official lists.

tools.name: cfpb_by_company
tools.description: Search MORVS's partial local CFPB complaint index by company. Returns indexed complaint counts, products, and narratives only where the CFPB published them. Check /coverage; this is not the full CFPB database.

tools.name: nih_by_org
tools.description: NIH RePORTER dossier for one organization — total federal R&D funding received, top activity codes, recent grants. Best for academic medical centers + biotechs.

tools.name: nhtsa_by_manufacturer
tools.description: NHTSA vehicle recall dossier for one auto OEM. Returns total recalls, top affected components, park-it count, recent recalls. Public auto OEMs only.

tools.name: doj_by_company
tools.description: DOJ press release search for one company. Surfaces FCPA, antitrust, healthcare fraud, environmental crimes, and any other DOJ enforcement actions mentioning the name. Body-text substring match across 266k+ press releases since 2009.

tools.name: kev_by_vendor
tools.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) for one tech vendor. Returns CVE list + ransomware count + top affected products. The federal government's canonical list of CVEs being actively exploited.

tools.name: kev_recent
tools.description: Recent CISA KEV entries. Filter by vendor or ransomware-known flag.

tools.name: nsf_by_org
tools.description: NSF Awards dossier for one organization — total funding, top programs, recent awards. Pairs with academic medical centers + biotech/tech startups.

tools.name: screen_all
tools.description: Experimental lookup of one name across MORVS's local public-record indexes; availability is not guaranteed. tools.name: lobbying_by_issue
tools.description: Who lobbies the federal government on a given issue. Takes an LDA issue code (e.g. HCR health, DEF defense, TAX, ENG energy, TRA transport) and returns top clients by reported spend. List codes at /api/v1/lobbying/issues.

tools.name: entity_relationships
tools.description: Company relationship graph (shared-officer edges): other companies whose Form-4 filings name the same person(s) as this entity — board interlock / multi-company executives / activist overlap. Accepts a ticker, CIK, or name.

tools.name: common_owner_rollup
tools.description: Trace one organization owner across every Medicare facility it controls (hospital/hospice/home-health/skilled-nursing): facility_count, per-sector breakdown, PE/REIT flags, state spread. Takes a CMS owner_associate_id (from /api/v1/owners/largest or /owners/private-equity).

tools.name: influence_chain
tools.description: Follow-the-money chain for one entity: federal contracts + prime->sub subaward flow + registered lobbying + FEC political committees + FEC enforcement (MURs), with dollar tallies. Accepts a company name or a 12-char UEI.

tools.name: dataset_freshness
tools.description: Per-dataset freshness across the federal data hub: FRESH/AGING/STALE/UNKNOWN vs each source's expected cadence, with age in days and separate last-successful-source-observation and indexed-content watermarks. Each row states which timestamp drives status. Optional status filter (FRESH/AGING/STALE/UN

tools.name: flagged_carriers
tools.description: FMCSA carriers flagged in one or more SMS BASIC safety categories (over the federal intervention threshold): Unsafe Driving, Hours-of-Service Compliance, Driver Fitness, Controlled Substances/Alcohol, Vehicle Maintenance. Returns carrier name, location, fleet size, which BASICs are flagged, and out-

tools.name: adviser_search
tools.description: Search SEC-registered investment advisers (RIAs + Exempt Reporting Advisers) by firm name. Returns CRD number, type, regulatory assets under management, state, and whether the firm has Form ADV Item 11 disciplinary disclosures. ~23.4k advisers covered.

tools.name: advisers_flagged
tools.description: SEC-registered investment advisers reporting Form ADV Item 11 disciplinary disclosures (criminal / regulatory / civil), ranked by disclosure count. ~2,291 advisers flagged. Filter by state, type (RIA/ERA), or kind (criminal/regulatory/civil).

tools.name: search_340b
tools.description: Search HRSA 340B Drug Pricing Program covered entities (disproportionate-share hospitals, FQHCs, clinics buying federally-discounted outpatient drugs) by name. Returns 340B ID, entity type, state, participating status, and contract-pharmacy count. ~93k entities.

tools.name: pharmacy_340b_clients
tools.description: Reverse 340B lookup: given a contract-pharmacy ID, list every 340B covered entity that dispenses its discounted drugs through that pharmacy — reveals how concentrated the contract-pharmacy network is around big chains. Pharmacy IDs come from a covered entity's detail page.

tools.name: bsee_search
tools.description: Search BSEE offshore oil & gas operators (US Outer Continental Shelf — Gulf of Mexico, Pacific, Alaska) by name. Returns each operator's incident-enforcement totals: warnings, component shut-ins, facility shut-ins. ~674 operators, 1948-2026.

tools.name: bsee_worst_operators
tools.description: Ranks offshore oil and gas operators by counts of BSEE incidents of noncompliance: facility shut-ins (default), component shut-ins, total events, or warnings. Counts come from BSEE records and are not adjusted for operator size or activity.

tools.name: fails_to_deliver_top
tools.description: SEC fails-to-deliver leaderboard — securities ranked by total fail-to-deliver shares over the rolling 12-month window. Fails-to-deliver are a settlement-stress / naked-short red flag tracked by retail investors and market-structure researchers.

tools.name: fails_to_deliver_search
tools.description: Search SEC fails-to-deliver by issuer name or ticker. Returns each security's total fail shares, peak single-day fail balance, and days-with-fails over the rolling 12-month window. CUSIP joins to the SEC securities/13F-holdings layer.

tools.name: short_interest_squeeze
tools.description: FINRA equity short interest: securities with the highest days-to-cover (the classic short-squeeze indicator) + the largest absolute short positions, from the latest bi-monthly settlement. TRUE short interest (not short volume). Use to find squeeze candidates and the most-shorted stocks. FINRA source

tools.name: short_interest_search

The real short metric (distinct from short volume which includes market-maker hedging). Pairs with fails-to-deliver + short volume. FINRA source terms: https://www.finra.org/terms-of-use.

tools.name: short_squeeze_candidates
tools.description: Top short-squeeze candidates by a MORVS (AI Analytics LLC) 0-100 pressure score combining FINRA days-to-cover + short-sale volume % + SEC fails-to-deliver per symbol. The methodology is separate from and does not relicense FINRA inputs. Transparent heuristic, not investment advice. FINRA source term

tools.name: chemical_accident_search
tools.description: Search EPA RMP hazardous-chemical facilities (Clean Air Act 112(r)) by facility or parent-company name. Returns each facility's chemical-accident count + location. ~99k facilities — the chemical-plant accident ledger EPA keeps FOIA-only (releases, fires, explosions, deaths).

tools.name: chemical_accident_worst
tools.description: Ranks parent companies by harm reported in EPA Risk Management Program accident histories: deaths (default), injuries, or accident count. Counts come from RMP filings and are not adjusted for company size or number of facilities.

tools.name: csb_investigation_search
tools.description: Search U.S. Chemical Safety Board (CSB) investigations of major chemical incidents — explosions, toxic releases, fires — by company, location, or keyword. ~139 independent root-cause investigations (BP Texas City, West Fertilizer, DuPont, etc.); the deep-investigation layer over EPA RMP chemical acc

tools.name: fcc_grantee_search
tools.description: Search FCC equipment-authorization grantees — the manufacturer/importer behind every FCC ID — by company name. ~50k grantees across 111 countries (China 12,962, Taiwan 3,717). A supply-chain lens that joins UFLPA forced-labor + trade-screening by name. Optional country filter.

tools.name: broadcast_station_search
tools.description: Search the FCC broadcast station directory by call sign or community of license. ~109,812 US over-the-air facilities (TV/FM/AM/LPTV/translators, ~32,883 active). Returns service, channel, frequency, community, status, and license expiration. Station facts only — no ownership.

tools.name: house_price_index_search
tools.description: Search the FHFA House Price Index by geography name (metro, state, census division). Returns the place_id to pull a full house-price appreciation history (1975-2026, purchase-only / all-transactions / expanded-data). Aggregate federal statistic — zero PII.

tools.name: crop_insurance_search
tools.description: Search USDA RMA crop-insurance Summary of Business by county/state name. Returns the place_id ({state_fips}-{county_fips}) to pull a county's underwriting history — liability, premium, subsidy, indemnity, loss ratio, top crops (1989-2026). Aggregate federal program statistic — zero PII.

tools.name: income_by_zip_search
tools.description: Search IRS SOI income statistics by ZIP code or state. Returns the 5-digit ZIP to pull its income/tax profile — returns, AGI, average AGI per return, wages, capital gains, EITC, charitable giving by 6 AGI brackets (TY2022). Aggregate federal statistic — zero PII.

tools.name: documented_vessel_search
tools.description: Search USCG documented vessels by name or official number. ~394,495 US-flag vessels (recreational, fishing, freight, towing, passenger). Returns service, flag, tonnage, length, build year, hull material, hailing port, and certificate-of-documentation status. Vessel/asset facts only — no owner names

tools.name: ag_census_county_search
tools.description: Search USDA Census of Agriculture by county/state name. Returns the place_id ({state_fips}-{county_code}) to pull a county's farm economy — number of farms, land in farms, market value of products sold, net farm income, and top commodities by sales (2022). Aggregate federal statistic — zero PII.

tools.name: building_permits_search
tools.description: Search Census Building Permits Survey by county/state name. Returns place_id ({state_fips}-{county_fips}) to pull a county's residential-construction permit history — buildings, housing units, and valuation by structure type (1-unit / 2-units / 3-4 / 5+), 2015-2025. Aggregate federal statistic — zer

tools.name: fair_market_rent_search
tools.description: Search HUD Fair Market Rents by area/county/state name. Returns place_id (10-digit HUD fips) to pull an area's FY2026 FMRs — the 40th-percentile gross rent by bedroom size (efficiency/0BR through 4BR). Sets Section 8 voucher payment standards. Aggregate dollar amounts — zero PII.

tools.name: migration_flows_search
tools.description: Search IRS county-to-county migration flows by county/state name. Returns place_id ({state_fips}-{county_fips}) to pull a county's net migration (returns/people/AGI in vs out, FY2022-2023) and its top origin/destination counties. Aggregate IRS statistic — zero PII.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Entity locator: resolve a company name/ticker/CIK to its canonical SEC identity + aliases, and an available_in map of which federal datasets contain it (with links). Use first to find an entity and discover where it has data.

tools.name: compare_entities
tools.description: Side-by-side compliance-risk comparison of two entities. Runs the full 40-source screen for each and returns both risk scores, an overall verdict (who is riskier), the risk gap, and the biggest per-vertical differences. Answers 'which counterparty is riskier' in one call.

tools.name: screen_batch
tools.description: Screen up to 50 entities in one call. Returns a per-entity risk_score + risk_level + per-vertical summary for each, plus the list sorted highest-risk-first. Use to vet a whole vendor / counterparty / portfolio list at once.

tools.name: debarments_check
tools.description: Screen a name against US federal contractor debarments (SAM Exclusions, ~10k entries) AND HHS OIG healthcare provider exclusions (LEIE, ~83k entries). Returns hit=true if any match. Use this for KYC + counterparty due diligence.

tools.name: doj_recent
tools.description: Recent DOJ Office of Public Affairs press releases. Filter by free-text query or DOJ component (Antitrust Division, USAO - SDNY, Criminal Division, ENRD, Civil Rights, etc.).

tools.name: nhtsa_recent
tools.description: Recent NHTSA vehicle recalls. Filter by manufacturer, make, model year. `park_it=1` returns only the most urgent recalls (do-not-drive).

tools.name: fed_enforcement_recent
tools.description: Federal Reserve banking enforcement actions (consent orders, written agreements, CMPs, removals). Optional `bank` filter.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lobbying_by_issue" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "fcc_grantee_search" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cross_vertical_active, lobbying_by_issue · Private data: news, cfpb_by_company, screen_all, common_owner_rollup, bsee_worst_operators · Public sink: flagged_carriers, search_340b, broadcast_station_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cross_vertical_active, lobbying_by_issue · Private data: news, cfpb_by_company, screen_all, common_owner_rollup, bsee_worst_operators · Public sink: flagged_carriers, search_340b, broadcast_station_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
